data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme following manufacturing theme
fund_options: Regular Plan-Payout of Income Distribution cum Capital Withdrawal (IDCW) Option
Direct Plan- Payout of IDCW Option
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to achieve long term capital appreciation by predominantly investing in equity and equity related instruments of companies following manufacturing theme. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Under normal circumstances, the asset allocation of the Scheme would be as follows: Equity and equity related instruments of companies following manufacturing theme: 80%-100% of the total assets, Equity and equity related instruments of other than above companies: 0%-20% of Total Assets, Debt and Money Market instruments: 0%-20% of the Total Assets, Units issued by InvITs: 0%-10% of the total assets. Please refer the Scheme Information Document for complete details.
data.benchmark: Nifty India Manufacturing Index (Total Return Index)
data.fund_managers: FM 1: Mr. Yogesh Patil ; FM 2: Mr. Mahesh Bendre
data.exit_load: 1. If units of the Scheme are redeemed / switched-out within 90 days from the date of allotment: a. Upto 12% of the units: No exit load will be levied b. Above 12% of the units: exit load of 1% will be levied 2. If units of the Scheme are redeemed /switched-out after 90 days from the date of allotment: No exit load will be levied.
